comment: The calendar reader's two sources, kept at their pinned bytes (the registries at app/specs/calendar/upstream/icalendar.xml, RFC 5545 among the standard texts at app/specs/standards/texts/<sha256>). generators/calendar's GenCalendar reads them (generators/pipeline.json) into site/calendar/registry.mjs, every element IANA registers for the standard with what the standard's section 3 says of it, and into ST-01's inventory of those elements (test/standards/generated/iana-icalendar.json).

registry.title: IANA iCalendar Element Registries (components, properties, parameters, value data types and their values)

text.title: RFC 5545 Internet Calendaring and Scheduling Core Object Specification (iCalendar)
